manager_check: Record incident ID, facility, exact gate, report time, reporter channel and affected direction
pass_or_complete_condition: Report is tied to one asset, time and direction
allowed_next_action: Clarify the exact entrance or exit without collecting unnecessary personal data
do_not_do: Do not copy a full access code, payment detail or unit contents into the incident record
evidence_or_reference: Incident ID plus facility and gate identifier

manager_check: Keep customers, employees and vehicles outside the gate travel and entrapment areas
pass_or_complete_condition: People and vehicles are positioned under the approved safe boundary
stop_or_restriction_condition: Person trapped or injured; collision; visible damage; abnormal movement; unsafe traffic queue
allowed_next_action: Use emergency services and site emergency plan when required; close or guard the affected lane
do_not_do: Do not ask anyone to walk through a vehicular gate, hold a sensor or stand beside moving equipment
evidence_or_reference: Boundary observation and emergency reference if used

manager_check: Choose normal, restricted, held open under authorized procedure, out of service or awaiting qualified review
pass_or_complete_condition: State matches observed condition and site authority
stop_or_restriction_condition: Safe condition cannot be bounded or required owner is unavailable
allowed_next_action: Hold normal use and escalate to the designated owner
do_not_do: Do not label equipment safe, repaired or compliant from a visual observation

manager_check: Record whether one or many users are affected and whether entry, exit or both are affected
pass_or_complete_condition: Scope is supported by authorized comparisons or remains explicitly unknown
stop_or_restriction_condition: Additional testing would require a bypass, credential change, schedule change or unsafe cycle
allowed_next_action: Perform only checks already authorized by site procedure
do_not_do: Do not reset, reprogram, force or repeatedly cycle equipment to diagnose

manager_check: Record credential, command, gate, passage and operating states independently
pass_or_complete_condition: Each state is recorded as observed, system-reported, unknown or not checked
stop_or_restriction_condition: One successful layer is being used to imply complete passage
allowed_next_action: Preserve the layers and escalate the unresolved boundary
do_not_do: Do not treat code accepted, command sent or gate open as proof of passage
evidence_or_reference: System reference and direct observation with timestamps

manager_check: Capture approved photos, displayed messages, exact timestamps, recent verified work and actions not taken
pass_or_complete_condition: Record is sufficient for a qualified handoff without unnecessary sensitive data
stop_or_restriction_condition: Evidence collection would expose credentials, customer data or a person to the movement zone
allowed_next_action: Collect only safe, policy-approved and necessary evidence
do_not_do: Do not expose security details or enter the gate travel area for a photograph
evidence_or_reference: Photo or log references; no raw credential

manager_check: Use approved wording stating the affected gate, current restriction and next update time
pass_or_complete_condition: Message is factual, bounded and visible in approved channels
stop_or_restriction_condition: Message promises repair timing, assigns unsupported blame or directs unsafe access
allowed_next_action: Publish or deliver only the approved current-state message
do_not_do: Do not say safe, fixed or reopened before return-to-service evidence exists
evidence_or_reference: Approved message version and channel readback

manager_check: Send asset, time, direction, observed behavior, current state, safety boundary, verified recent work and on-site contact
pass_or_complete_condition: Qualified owner accepts the handoff and supplies a ticket or reference
stop_or_restriction_condition: No qualified owner; uncontrolled hazard; emergency-access concern
allowed_next_action: Use the next approved escalation tier or emergency plan
do_not_do: Do not open panels, bypass safeguards, perform untrained servicing or improvise a manual release
evidence_or_reference: Vendor ticket, callback owner and promised response time
assigned_owner: Facilities owner or qualified gate vendor

manager_check: Record dispatched, on site, work reported complete and technical test complete as separate states
pass_or_complete_condition: Current work state has owner, timestamp and supporting receipt
stop_or_restriction_condition: A verbal update is being treated as operating closure
allowed_next_action: Request the required repair and test record under the service agreement
do_not_do: Do not close the incident because a technician was dispatched or said work was done
evidence_or_reference: Dispatch receipt, work record and test evidence

manager_check: Verify technical evidence, approved safe test, correct entry and exit behavior, removal of temporary controls and current customer message
pass_or_complete_condition: Facility operating owner records return-to-service time and evidence
stop_or_restriction_condition: Required test failed, condition remains uncertain or temporary boundary cannot be removed
allowed_next_action: Keep affected gate restricted and continue escalation
do_not_do: Do not reopen on a credential result, remote command or unverified vendor statement alone

manager_check: Close customer incident; open separate corrective actions for alerting, procedure, training, preventive work or vendor follow-through
pass_or_complete_condition: Incident and each corrective action have distinct owner, due date and closure evidence
stop_or_restriction_condition: Repeat condition lacks root-cause review or owner
allowed_next_action: Schedule a systems review and next-shift handoff
do_not_do: Do not hide recurring failure by repeatedly closing only the immediate symptom
evidence_or_reference: Closed incident record and corrective-action references
